display.purpose: The name on the hero marquee, as hand-hung letter tiles.

headline.purpose: Every section title, as a letterboard.

body.purpose: Descriptions and notes, max 54ch; also the tools line (500, 0.8125rem, 0.03em, sentence case).

lede.purpose: Statement, About text and contact lede.

label.purpose: Nav, lamp, dates, links and buttons.

shadows.name: play-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifts the round play button off video posters; the only shadow.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Every state transition (hover, press, tile swing).

motion.name: chase
motion.value: 1.05s linear, 4 iterations, forwards (ends opacity 1); three bulb phases offset by 0.35s
motion.purpose: Chaser bulbs on canopies: start on first scroll/pointer move when the canopy is on screen, run about 4.2s, settle fully lit; re-run on pointerenter (WCAG 2.2.2).

motion.name: slot
motion.value: one scroll-driven animation per board (view-timeline, cover 0% to 34%) animating registered --put 0 to 1; each tile derives a staggered --k (1.3% per letter, 12% window)
motion.purpose: Letters are put up one by one on the Marketing Creatives and closing Let’s Work Together boards only; all other boards are static.

motion.name: drift
motion.purpose: The poster reel under the hero canopy slides sideways with page scroll.

motion.name: push
motion.value: scroll-driven view(), entry 0% to cover 45%, scale 1.12 to 1
motion.purpose: The feature poster art settles into its case as it enters (feature poster only).

motion.name: spot
motion.purpose: Project titles come up to full light as they reach reading position.

components.name: Ticket (primary action)

components.html: Email me
components.css: .ds-ticket{position:relative;isolation:isolate;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem;min-height:3.5rem;padding:0 1.6rem 0 1.15rem;color:#1c1306;text-decoration:none;font:800 1.4rem/1 "Sofia Sans Extra Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-ticket::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:#ffc25a;-webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle .5rem at 0 50%, #0000 98%, #000) left / 51% 100% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle .5rem at 100% 50%, #0000 98%, #000) right / 51% 100% no-repeat;mask:radial-gradient(circle .5rem at 0 50%, #0000 98%, #000) left / 51% 100% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle .5rem at 100% 50%, #0000 98%, #000) right / 51% 100% no-repeat;transition:background-color .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-stub{display:grid;place-items:center;align-self:stretch;padding:0 .8rem 0 .35rem;border-right:2px dashed rgb(28 19 6/.4)}.ds-ticket svg{transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-ticket:hover::before{background:#ffd88f}.ds-ticket:hover svg{transform:translateX(2px) rotate(-6deg)}.ds-ticket:active::before{transform:scale(.97)}.ds-ticket:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffc25a;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Line button (secondary)
components.css: .ds-line{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;min-height:3.5rem;padding:0 1.3rem;border:1.5px solid rgb(241 235 223/.4);border-radius:2px;color:#f1ebdf;background:#0c0b10;text-decoration:none;font:750 1.3rem/1 "Sofia Sans Extra Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:border-color .18s,color .18s}.ds-line:hover{border-color:#ffc25a;color:#ffc25a}.ds-line:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffc25a;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Letterboard
components.description: Section title as a backlit milk-glass board in a steel frame: rail grooves under each row of tiles and each hand-hung letter on its own faint tile.
components.html: PROJECTS
components.css: .ds-board{display:inline-flex;margin:0;padding:.28em .4em .24em;font:800 3.5rem/1 "Sofia Sans Extra Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;color:#17141a;background:radial-gradient(130% 160% at 50% -10%,#fffaf0 0%,#f6edd8 45%,#e3d2ad 100%);border:8px solid #23212b;outline:1px solid #3a3744}.ds-board{background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 0 .95em,rgb(60 44 22/.26) .95em .985em,rgb(255 255 255/.6) .985em 1.01em,transparent 1.01em 1.08em),radial-gradient(130% 160% at 50% -10%,#fffaf0 0%,#f6edd8 45%,#e3d2ad 100%)}.ds-t{display:inline-block;padding:.06em .035em .02em;margin-inline:.02em;line-height:.9;background:rgb(255 255 255/.35);box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgb(0 0 0/.18),inset 0 -1px 0 rgb(0 0 0/.08)}.ds-t:nth-child(3n+1){rotate:-1.4deg}.ds-t:nth-child(4n+2){rotate:1.1deg;translate:0 .025em}.ds-t:nth-child(5n+3){rotate:-.5deg}

narrative.overview:
The page is a provincial cinema seen from the street after dark. His name is up on the marquee in slotted plastic letters on backlit milk glass, a steel canopy carries rows of chaser bulbs, the creatives hang in steel poster cases, the projects read like a program of showings, work history rolls like end credits, and the page closes on a second marquee where the box office is open. The ground is a blue-black night; light is the only accent, and light always means something is live or on offer.

Type is the spectacle. The letterboard face is set as large as the viewport allows and every letter sits slightly askew on its rail, the way a changer hangs them by hand. Everything outside the boards is quiet: warm lamp-white prose, dusk-grey captions, generous dark space between sections. The first viewport is the marquee plus the box office, with the actual creatives already drifting past underneath.

This world replaced the earlier "Personal Data Sheet" green form world; that look, the white/blue rounded-card template, and the marketing site's navy/gold Messenger-thread world are all anti-references.
keyCharacteristics: Blue-black night ground, never pure black, never a gradient wash.
Backlit milk-glass letterboards in black and cinema-red condensed letters, each letter its own slightly rotated tile.
Amber bulb light as the single accent: chaser rails, the AVAILABLE lamp, skill bullets, links, the ticket CTA.
Steel-framed poster cases with a near-black mat; artwork is never cropped past its headline.
Motion belongs to the marquee: bulbs that chase a few rounds then settle lit, letters put up one by one on the two signature boards, posters drifting under the canopy.

rules.name: The Lit Means Live Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only on things that are on: the availability lamp, actions, live links, lit bulbs. Never as a decorative wash or a glow behind content. A project link to a running demo carries a lit bulb before its label; links to sheets and forms do not.

rules.name: The Glass Only Rule
rules.body: Light grounds exist only as letterboards and certificate mats. Sections, cards and panels stay on the night.

rules.name: The Two Widths Rule
rules.body: Condensed is for anything that would be lettered on the building (boards, titles, labels, buttons); regular width is for anything you would read in the program. Never set prose in the condensed cut.

rules.name: The Hand-Hung Rule
rules.body: Board letters are separate tiles with small, varied rotations (−1.4° to 1.8°) and offsets. Never set a board as a straight text string.

rules.name: The Slotted Board Rule
rules.body: Every board reads as a changeable letterboard: rail grooves under each row of tiles and each letter on its own faint tile.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: No coloured halos or glow shadows on the night ground. Bulbs carry their own small light inside their drawing; nothing else glows.

dos: **Do** set every section title as a letterboard of individual tiles, with screen-reader text in an sr-only span and the tiles aria-hidden.

**Do** keep motion optional (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference): chaser bulbs run 4 rounds and settle fully lit, starting on first scroll/pointer move and re-running on canopy hover; letters are put up only on #creatives-h and #contact-h (one animation per board); push-in on the feature poster only; scroll-driven motion inside @supports (animation-timeline: view()).
**Do** keep first-viewport content visible at rest: no opacity-0 starts, no load-time staggered entrances.
**Do** mark links that leave the page with the arrow-out icon and "(opens in a new tab)" sr-only text.
**Do** keep every URL relative; the page lives under /portfolio/.
**Do** keep credits as role on the left, then company, dates and notes on the right; never dates above the role.
donts: **Don't** reuse the Personal Data Sheet form look, the white/blue rounded-card template, or the marketing site's navy/gold Messenger-thread world.
**Don't** add coloured glow shadows, gradient text, glassmorphism or radial halo washes on the night ground.
**Don't** use amber for decoration; it marks only lit, live or actionable things.
**Don't** autoplay video with sound or add looping motion that keeps running off-screen.
**Don't** set prose in the condensed face or boards in the regular one.
